tool_schemas.name: change_default_account
tool_schemas.description: Sets the locally-managed account identified by account_id as the current default account and returns the updated default account record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if no account exists with that ID, and CONFLICT if the account exists but is not eligible to be set as default (for example, it is archived).

account_id.description: ID of the account to set as the current default.

tool_schemas.name: create_account
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new locally-managed COTI account by generating a random private key and AES key, stores it, and returns the new account ID, address, and the newly generated keys. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if label is present but invalid for this service (e.g., wrong type), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the service refuses to create additional accounts due to configured limits.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the new account.

tool_schemas.name: decrypt_value
tool_schemas.description: Decrypts ciphertext using the AES key for account_id, or the current default account when account_id is omitted, and returns the decrypted plaintext value. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ciphertext is missing/invalid or account_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if the referenced (or default) account does not exist, and CONFLICT if no AES key is available for that account or the ciphertext cannot be decrypted with that key.

ciphertext.description: Ciphertext string to decrypt using the current account AES key.

account_id.description: Account ID whose AES key should be used; defaults to the current default account when omitted.

tool_schemas.name: encrypt_value
tool_schemas.description: Encrypts value for the given contract_address and function_selector using the AES key for account_id (or the current default account) and returns the resulting encrypted payload/signature. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if value/contract_address/function_selector are missing or malformed (including a non-0x-prefixed 4-byte selector) or if account_id format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the referenced (or default) account does not exist, and CONFLICT if the account has no AES key available to perform encryption.

contract_address.description: Target contract address the encrypted value is intended for.

function_selector.description: 4-byte function selector (0x-prefixed hex) for the target function.

account_id.description: Account ID whose AES key should be used; defaults to the current default account when omitted.

tool_schemas.name: export_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Exports all locally-managed accounts as a JSON backup string, optionally including archived accounts, and returns that string for later import. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if include_archived is not a boolean, and CONFLICT if export cannot be produced due to an internal consistency issue with stored account material.

include_archived.description: Whether to include archived accounts in the exported JSON backup.

tool_schemas.name: generate_aes_key
tool_schemas.description: Generates (rotates) and stores a new AES key for account_id, or for the current default account when omitted, and returns the new AES key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is provided but does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if the referenced (or default) account does not exist, and CONFLICT if the account is not eligible for key rotation (for example, it is archived).

account_id.description: Account ID to rotate/generate a new AES key for; defaults to the current default account when omitted.

tool_schemas.name: import_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Imports locally-managed accounts from backup_json previously produced by export_accounts and returns a summary of what was created, updated, or skipped; if set_first_as_default is true, it sets the first imported account as the default only when no default is currently set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if backup_json is not valid JSON in the expected export format or if flags are not booleans, CONFLICT if an imported account collides with an existing account and overwrite_duplicates is false, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the import would exceed configured account limits.

backup_json.description: JSON backup string previously produced by export_accounts.

set_first_as_default.description: Whether to set the first imported account as default when no default exists.

overwrite_duplicates.description: Whether to overwrite existing accounts when an imported account conflicts (e.g., same address).

tool_schemas.name: list_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally-managed accounts, optionally filtered by status, and returns a paged result set sorted by the requested field and order along with the current default account indicator; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status/sort/order are not one of the supported values, if limit is outside the allowed range, or if cursor is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if cursor refers to a page that no longer exists.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of results.

order.description: Sort order for the selected sort field.

tool_schemas.name: sign_message
tool_schemas.description: Signs message using the private key for account_id, or the current default account when account_id is omitted, and returns the signature. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message is missing/invalid or account_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if the referenced (or default) account does not exist, and CONFLICT if the account has no private key available for signing or is not eligible to sign (for example, it is archived).

account_id.description: ID of the locally-managed COTI account whose private key will be used to sign.

tool_schemas.name: verify_signature
tool_schemas.description: Verifies signature against message and returns the recovered signer address when verification succeeds. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message or signature are missing or malformed, and CONFLICT if the signature cannot be validated for the given message (including signatures that do not recover to a valid address).

message.description: The original message that was signed.

signature.description: The signature to verify (hex string or provider-native signature encoding).

tool_schemas.name: approve_erc20_spender
tool_schemas.description: Submits an ERC20 `approve` transaction from the specified locally-managed account (or the current default account when `account_id` is omitted) to authorize `spender_address` to spend up to `amount` from the owner for `token_contract_address` on `chain_id`, and returns the submitted transaction hash. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any required field is missing, an address is malformed, or `amount` is not a non-negative base-units integer string; raises NOT_FOUND when `account_id` is provided but no such locally-managed account exists. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the account is not available for signing, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server refuses the request due to configured rate/usage limits.

account_id.description: ID of the locally-managed COTI account initiating the approval transaction.

chain_id.description: Chain ID on which to submit the approval transaction.

amount.description: Amount to approve, as a base-units integer string.

tool_schemas.name: deploy_private_erc20_contract
tool_schemas.description: Deploys a standard private ERC20 contract on `chain_id` from the specified locally-managed account (or the current default account when `account_id` is omitted) using `name`, `symbol`, and `decimals`, and returns the new contract address and records its metadata for later lookups. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or invalid (including non-integer/negative `decimals`), and raises NOT_FOUND when `account_id` is provided but does not match a locally-managed account. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the deployer account cannot be used to sign, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when deployment is refused due to server-side limits.

account_id.description: ID of the locally-managed COTI account that will deploy the contract.

chain_id.description: Chain ID on which to deploy the private ERC20 contract.

name.description: Token name to set in the deployed contract.

symbol.description: Token symbol to set in the deployed contract.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to set in the deployed contract.

tool_schemas.name: get_erc20_allowance
tool_schemas.description: Reads the ERC20 allowance for `spender_address` from `owner_address` for `token_contract_address` on `chain_id` and returns the allowance as a base-units integer string. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any required field is missing or an address is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the token contract cannot be read on the specified chain, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read calls are refused due to server-side limits.

chain_id.description: Chain ID on which to read the allowance.

owner_address.description: Owner address whose allowance is being queried.

spender_address.description: Spender address whose allowance is being queried.

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc20_balance
tool_schemas.description: Reads the private ERC20 balance for `account_address` at `token_contract_address` on `chain_id` and returns the decrypted balance using the keys of the specified locally-managed `account_id` (or the current default account when `account_id` is omitted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or an address is malformed, and NOT_FOUND when `account_id` is provided but no such locally-managed account exists. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the server cannot use the account keys to decrypt the balance, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read calls are refused due to server-side limits.

account_id.description: ID of the locally-managed COTI account used to decrypt and return the private token balance.

chain_id.description: Chain ID on which to read the private token balance.

account_address.description: COTI account address to query the balance for.

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc20_decimals
tool_schemas.description: Reads `decimals` from the private ERC20 contract at `token_contract_address` on `chain_id` and returns it as an integer. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `token_contract_address` is missing or malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the contract cannot be read on the specified chain, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read calls are refused due to server-side limits.

chain_id.description: Chain ID on which to read the token decimals.

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc20_total_supply
tool_schemas.description: Reads `totalSupply` from the private ERC20 contract at `token_contract_address` on `chain_id` and returns it as a base-units integer string. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `token_contract_address` is missing or malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when the contract cannot be read on the specified chain, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read calls are refused due to server-side limits.

chain_id.description: Chain ID on which to read the token total supply.

tool_schemas.name: mint_private_erc20_token
tool_schemas.description: Submits a mint transaction on `chain_id` to mint `amount` (base-units integer string) from the private ERC20 contract at `contract_address` to `to_address`, signed by the specified locally-managed `account_id` (or the current default account when omitted), and returns the submitted transaction hash. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, an address is malformed, or `amount` is not a positive base-10 integer string; raises NOT_FOUND when `account_id` is provided but no such locally-managed account exists. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the signing account cannot submit the transaction (including lacking required on-chain mint permission), CONFLICT when the request is refused due to an incompatible on-chain state for minting, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the server refuses the submission due to configured limits.

contract_address.description: Private ERC20 contract address to mint from.

to_address.description: Recipient address to receive the newly minted tokens.

amount.description: Token amount to mint, expressed in the token's smallest units as a base-10 string.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id used to initiate/sign the mint transaction (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to submit the transaction on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: transfer_private_erc20
tool_schemas.description: Submits a private ERC20 transfer transaction on `chain_id` to send `amount` (base-units integer string) from the signer’s account to `to_address` for the token contract at `contract_address`, and returns the submitted transaction hash. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, an address is malformed, or `amount` is not a positive base-10 integer string; raises NOT_FOUND when `account_id` is provided but no such locally-managed account exists. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the signing account cannot submit the transfer (including insufficient spendable balance/permissions as enforced by the contract), CONFLICT when the transfer is refused due to incompatible contract state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when submissions are refused due to server-side limits.

contract_address.description: Private ERC20 contract address to transfer tokens from.

to_address.description: Recipient address to receive the tokens.

amount.description: Token amount to transfer, expressed in the token's smallest units as a base-10 string.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id used to initiate/sign the transfer transaction (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to submit the transaction on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: approve_private_erc721
tool_schemas.description: Submits an approval transaction on `chain_id` for the private ERC721 contract at `contract_address` to approve `spender_address` to transfer the specific `token_id`, signed by the specified locally-managed `account_id` (or the current default account when omitted), and returns the submitted transaction hash. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, an address is malformed, or `token_id` is not a base-10 integer string; raises NOT_FOUND when `account_id` is provided but no such locally-managed account exists. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the signer is not permitted by the contract to approve the token (e.g., not owner/authorized operator), CONFLICT when approval is refused due to token/contract state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when submissions are refused due to server-side limits.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address for the NFT collection.

token_id.description: NFT token id to approve for transfer, as a base-10 string.

spender_address.description: Address to approve to transfer the specified NFT.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id used to initiate/sign the approval transaction (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to submit the transaction on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: deploy_private_erc721_contract
tool_schemas.description: Deploys a standard private ERC721 contract on `chain_id` from the specified locally-managed account (or the current default account when `account_id` is omitted) using `name` and `symbol`, and returns the new contract address and records its metadata for later lookups. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or invalid, and NOT_FOUND when `account_id` is provided but does not match a locally-managed account. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the deployer account cannot be used to sign, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when deployment is refused due to server-side limits.

name.description: Name of the new private ERC721 NFT collection.

symbol.description: Symbol/ticker of the new private ERC721 NFT collection.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id used to deploy/sign the contract deployment (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to deploy the contract on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc721_approved
tool_schemas.description: Returns the currently approved operator address for `token_id` on the given private ERC721 `contract_address` by executing a read call in the provided `account_id`/`chain_id` context (or the server defaults) and records the read result for later inspection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contract_address`/`token_id` are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the referenced local `account_id` does not exist (when provided), and RPC_ERROR if the chain read fails or the contract call reverts (including for non-existent tokens). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the request is not permitted for the selected local account context, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address for the NFT collection.

token_id.description: NFT token id to query, as a base-10 string.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id context for the read call (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to execute the read call on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc721_balance
tool_schemas.description: Returns the ERC721 balance (number of NFTs owned) for `account_address` in the private ERC721 collection at `contract_address` via a read call on the selected `chain_id`, and stores the decoded result in the interaction audit trail. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required address is missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if a provided `account_id` is unknown, and RPC_ERROR if the call fails or reverts. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for disallowed access to the local account context and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate/usage limits are hit.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address for the NFT collection.

account_address.description: Address to check the NFT balance for.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id context for the read call (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to execute the read call on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc721_is_approved_for_all
tool_schemas.description: Checks whether `operator_address` is approved to manage all tokens owned by `owner_address` for the private ERC721 `contract_address`, returning a boolean from a read call executed in the specified or default `account_id`/`chain_id` context and persisted to the read-call history. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid addresses, NOT_FOUND if the specified local `account_id` does not exist, and RPC_ERROR if the chain call fails or the contract reverts. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use the chosen local account context and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if usage limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address for the NFT collection.

owner_address.description: Owner address whose approvals are being checked.

operator_address.description: Operator address to check approval status for.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id context for the read call (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to execute the read call on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc721_token_owner
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current owner address for `token_id` on the private ERC721 `contract_address` by executing an on-chain read call and storing the decoded result for repeatable reads/status checks. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if a provided local `account_id` cannot be resolved, and RPC_ERROR if the call fails or reverts (including when `token_id` does not exist). Raises UNAUTHORIZED for unauthorized access to the local account context and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address for the NFT collection.

token_id.description: NFT token id to query, as a base-10 string.

account_id.description: Locally-managed account id context for the read call (uses default if omitted).

chain_id.description: Chain id to execute the read call on (uses server default if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc721_token_uri
tool_schemas.description: Returns the tokenURI for `token_id` on `contract_address`, decrypting private metadata when required using the specified `account_id` (or the default local account) and recording the read and decoded value in the audit trail. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contract_address`/`token_id` are missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if the given `account_id` does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the selected local account cannot be used to perform required decryption. Raises RPC_ERROR if the on-chain call fails or reverts (including for non-existent tokens) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if usage limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address to query.

token_id.description: Token ID to retrieve the tokenURI for (as a string to avoid integer size limits).

account_id.description: Locally-managed COTI account id to use for decrypting private metadata, if required.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to target for the read call.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_private_erc721_token_uri(contract_address, token_id, account_id=None, chain_id=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, secrets, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0345000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0345000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "get_private_erc721_token_uri"
    status_code = "succeeded"
    used_account_id = None

    ops = _load("crypto_operations.json")
    accounts = _load("accounts.json")
    contracts = _load("contracts.json")

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        # vendor-like stable ids: PREFIX + random uppercase base32-ish
        alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567"
        s = "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(22))
        return f"{prefix}_{s}"

    def _mask(enc):
        if enc is None:
            return None
        s = str(enc)
        if len(s) <= 10:
            return "***"
        return s[:6] + "…" + s[-4:]

    def _is_addr(a):
        return isinstance(a, str) and re.fullmatch(r"^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$", a or "") is not None

    def _is_token_id(t):
        if not isinstance(t, str) or len(t) == 0:
            return False
        return re.fullmatch(r"^[0-9]+$", t) is not None

    # Validate inputs
    if not _is_addr(contract_address):
        status_code = "failed"
        # audit before return
        op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
        ts = _now()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "op_type": "call_contract_function",
            "account_id": None,
            "contract_address": contract_address if isinstance(contract_address, str) else None,
            "function_selector": None,
            "function_name": "tokenURI",
            "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "token_id": token_id, "chain_id": chain_id},
            "result_json": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Invalid contract_address format.",
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts
        })
        _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "contract_address is missing or invalid.")
    if not _is_token_id(token_id):
        status_code = "failed"
        op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
        ts = _now()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "op_type": "call_contract_function",
            "account_id": None,
            "contract_address": contract_address,
            "function_selector": None,
            "function_name": "tokenURI",
            "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "token_id": token_id, "chain_id": chain_id},
            "result_json": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Invalid token_id format; must be a non-negative integer string.",
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts
        })
        _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "token_id is missing or invalid.")

    # Resolve account: explicit account_id -> must exist; else use default active account
    acct = None
    if account_id is not None:
        if not isinstance(account_id, str) or re.fullmatch(r"^coti_acct_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", account_id) is None:
            status_code = "failed"
            op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
            ts = _now()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "op_type": "call_contract_function",
                "account_id": None,
                "contract_address": contract_address,
                "function_selector": None,
                "function_name": "tokenURI",
                "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "token_id": token_id, "chain_id": chain_id, "account_id": account_id},
                "result_json": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "error_message": "Invalid account_id format.",
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts
            })
            _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "account_id is invalid.")
        for a in accounts:
            if a.get("id") == account_id:
                acct = a
                break
        if acct is None:
            status_code = "failed"
            op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
            ts = _now()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "op_type": "call_contract_function",
                "account_id": account_id,
                "contract_address": contract_address,
                "function_selector": None,
                "function_name": "tokenURI",
                "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "token_id": token_id, "chain_id": chain_id, "account_id": account_id},
                "result_json": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "error_message": "Account not found.",
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts
            })
            _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "account_id does not exist.")
        if acct.get("status") != "active":
            # described as UNAUTHORIZED when selected local account cannot serve the call
            status_code = "failed"
            op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
            ts = _now()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "op_type": "call_contract_function",
                "account_id": acct.get("id"),
                "contract_address": contract_address,
                "function_selector": None,
                "function_name": "tokenURI",
                "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "token_id": token_id, "chain_id": chain_id, "account_id": account_id},
                "result_json": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "error_message": "Account is not active.",
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts
            })
            _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Selected local account is not active.")
    else:
        defaults = [a for a in accounts if a.get("status") == "active" and a.get("is_default") is True]
        if defaults:
            acct = defaults[0]
        else:
            # If no account context exists, treat as unauthorized per description snippet.
            status_code = "failed"
            op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
            ts = _now()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "op_type": "call_contract_function",
                "account_id": None,
                "contract_address": contract_address,
                "function_selector": None,
                "function_name": "tokenURI",
                "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "token_id": token_id, "chain_id": chain_id},
                "result_json": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "error_message": "No default active account available.",
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts
            })
            _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No default active local account is available to decrypt private metadata.")

    used_account_id = acct.get("id")

    # Check that we have an AES key to decrypt "private" metadata when required.
    # With no on-chain access here, we model "private decryption required" as: contract is known private_erc721 OR token_uri looks like coti:enc:...
    contract_row = None
    for c in contracts:
        if isinstance(c.get("address"), str) and c.get("address").lower() == contract_address.lower() and c.get("status") == "active":
            if chain_id is None or c.get("chain_id") == chain_id:
                contract_row = c
                break

    # Deterministic placeholder tokenURI derived from inputs to simulate a chain read.
    # If it is a "private" contract, return a "decrypted" value only if AES key exists.
    is_private_contract = (contract_row is not None and contract_row.get("contract_type") == "private_erc721")

    # Build a pseudo "encrypted token uri" then optionally decrypt.
    digest = hashlib.sha256((contract_address.lower() + "|" + str(chain_id) + "|" + token_id).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    encrypted_like = "coti:enc:" + digest

    if is_private_contract:
        if acct.get("aes_key_encrypted") is None:
            status_code = "failed"
            op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
            ts = _now()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "op_type": "decrypt_value",
                "account_id": used_account_id,
                "contract_address": contract_address,
                "function_selector": "0x" + digest[:8],
                "function_name": "tokenURI",
                "inputs_json": {"token_id": token_id, "ciphertext": encrypted_like, "chain_id": chain_id},
                "result_json": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "error_message": "Account has no aes_key_encrypted; cannot decrypt private tokenURI.",
                "created_at": ts,
                "updated_at": ts
            })
            _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Account cannot decrypt private metadata (aes_key_encrypted is missing).")

        # "Decrypt": deterministic decoding to a normal URL
        token_uri_value = f"https://private.coti.local/erc721/{contract_address.lower()}/{token_id}?v={digest[:16]}"
        ts = _now()
        op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "op_type": "decrypt_value",
            "account_id": used_account_id,
            "contract_address": contract_address,
            "function_selector": "0x" + digest[:8],
            "function_name": "tokenURI",
            "inputs_json": {"token_id": token_id, "ciphertext": encrypted_like, "chain_id": chain_id, "aes_key_encrypted_masked": _mask(acct.get("aes_key_encrypted"))},
            "result_json": {"token_uri": token_uri_value},
            "status": "succeeded",
            "error_message": None,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts
        })
        _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
        return {
            "contract_address": contract_address,
            "chain_id": chain_id if chain_id is not None else (contract_row.get("chain_id") if contract_row else None),
            "token_id": token_id,
            "token_uri": token_uri_value,
            "crypto_operation_id": op_id,
            "metadata": {"contract_type": "private_erc721", "decrypted": True}
        }
    else:
        # Non-private: record as a call (read) operation succeeded
        token_uri_value = f"https://metadata.local/erc721/{contract_address.lower()}/{token_id}?h={digest[:16]}"
        ts = _now()
        op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "op_type": "call_contract_function",
            "account_id": used_account_id,
            "contract_address": contract_address,
            "function_selector": "0x" + digest[:8],
            "function_name": "tokenURI",
            "inputs_json": {"token_id": token_id, "chain_id": chain_id},
            "result_json": {"token_uri": token_uri_value},
            "status": "succeeded",
            "error_message": None,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts
        })
        _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
        return {
            "contract_address": contract_address,
            "chain_id": chain_id if chain_id is not None else (contract_row.get("chain_id") if contract_row else None),
            "token_id": token_id,
            "token_uri": token_uri_value,
            "crypto_operation_id": op_id,
            "metadata": {"contract_type": (contract_row.get("contract_type") if contract_row else "generic"), "decrypted": False}
        }

tool_schemas.name: get_private_erc721_total_supply
tool_schemas.description: Returns the total minted supply for the private ERC721 collection at `contract_address` by executing a read call on the specified `chain_id` and persisting the decoded result for later retrieval. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contract_address` is missing/invalid and RPC_ERROR if the chain call fails or the contract reverts (including if the contract does not implement `totalSupply`). Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address to query.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to target for the read call.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_private_erc721_total_supply(contract_address, chain_id=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, secrets, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0345000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0345000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    ops = _load("crypto_operations.json")
    contracts = _load("contracts.json")
    txs = _load("transactions.json")

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567"
        s = "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(22))
        return f"{prefix}_{s}"

    def _is_addr(a):
        return isinstance(a, str) and re.fullmatch(r"^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$", a or "") is not None

    # Validate inputs
    if not _is_addr(contract_address):
        ts = _now()
        op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "op_type": "call_contract_function",
            "account_id": None,
            "contract_address": contract_address if isinstance(contract_address, str) else None,
            "function_selector": None,
            "function_name": "totalSupply",
            "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "chain_id": chain_id},
            "result_json": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Invalid contract_address format.",
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts
        })
        _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "contract_address is missing or invalid.")

    # QUOTA: cap total call_contract_function ops per day (simple observable quota)
    # If exceeded, refuse with QUOTA_EXCEEDED.
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    day_start = now_dt.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    def _parse_ts(s):
        try:
            if isinstance(s, str) and s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    daily_calls = 0
    for o in ops:
        if o.get("op_type") == "call_contract_function":
            ts = _parse_ts(o.get("created_at"))
            if ts is not None and ts >= day_start:
                daily_calls += 1
    # Choose a conservative local quota
    DAILY_QUOTA = 5000
    if daily_calls >= DAILY_QUOTA:
        # Still record the refused call
        ts = _now()
        op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "op_type": "call_contract_function",
            "account_id": None,
            "contract_address": contract_address,
            "function_selector": None,
            "function_name": "totalSupply",
            "inputs_json": {"contract_address": contract_address, "chain_id": chain_id},
            "result_json": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Daily quota exceeded.",
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts
        })
        _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily quota exceeded for contract read calls.", quota={"daily_limit": DAILY_QUOTA})

    # "RPC call": deterministically derive total supply from existing mint txs to this contract on this chain
    # plus a stable base derived from contract address (so it doesn't always show 0).
    base = int(hashlib.sha256((contract_address.lower() + "|" + str(chain_id)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 3
    minted = 0
    for tx in txs:
        if tx.get("tx_type") == "private_erc721_mint":
            if isinstance(tx.get("to_address"), str) and tx.get("to_address").lower() == contract_address.lower():
                if chain_id is None or tx.get("chain_id") == chain_id:
                    minted += 1

    total_supply = base + minted

    # Persist decoded result into audit trail
    ts = _now()
    op_id = _gen_id("coti_op")
    ops.append({
        "id": op_id,
        "op_type": "call_contract_function",
        "account_id": None,
        "contract_address": contract_address,
        "function_selector": "0x18160ddd",  # totalSupply()
        "function_name": "totalSupply",
        "inputs_json": {"chain_id": chain_id},
        "result_json": {"total_supply": str(total_supply)},
        "status": "succeeded",
        "error_message": None,
        "created_at": ts,
        "updated_at": ts
    })
    _save("crypto_operations.json", ops)

    # Optional: if we know this contract row, refresh updated_at to show it was accessed
    updated = False
    for c in contracts:
        if isinstance(c.get("address"), str) and c.get("address").lower() == contract_address.lower():
            if chain_id is None or c.get("chain_id") == chain_id:
                c["updated_at"] = ts
                updated = True
                break
    if updated:
        _save("contracts.json", contracts)

    return {
        "contract_address": contract_address,
        "chain_id": chain_id,
        "total_supply": str(total_supply),
        "crypto_operation_id": op_id
    }

tool_schemas.name: mint_private_erc721_token
tool_schemas.description: Submits a mint transaction to the private ERC721 contract at `contract_address` to mint a new token to `to_address` with `token_uri`, returning the transaction hash (and the minted token id when it can be decoded from the receipt/logs) and recording the submission plus decoded logs/results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs, NOT_FOUND if the signing `account_id` is not a locally-managed account (or no default account is set), and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use that local account to sign. Raises CONFLICT if the server cannot select a signer (e.g., multiple accounts but no default), RPC_ERROR if the transaction is rejected/reverts (e.g., not authorized to mint), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if submission limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address to mint from.

to_address.description: Recipient address that will receive the newly minted NFT.

token_uri.description: Token metadata URI to set for the minted token.

account_id.description: Locally-managed COTI account id that will initiate/sign the mint transaction.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to submit the transaction to.

tool_schemas.name: set_private_erc721_approval_for_all
tool_schemas.description: Submits a transaction to `contract_address` to set or revoke operator approval for `operator_address` according to `approved`, returning the transaction hash and recording the transaction plus decoded receipt/logs for status and audit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs, NOT_FOUND if the provided `account_id` is unknown (or no default account is set), and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot sign with the selected local account. Raises CONFLICT if no signing account context can be resolved, RPC_ERROR if the transaction is rejected/reverts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address to set approval on.

operator_address.description: Operator address to approve or revoke.

approved.description: Whether the operator is approved (true) or revoked (false).

account_id.description: Locally-managed COTI account id that will initiate/sign the approval transaction.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to submit the transaction to.

tool_schemas.name: transfer_private_erc721
tool_schemas.description: Submits a transfer transaction for `token_id` on the private ERC721 `contract_address` from the signing local account to `to_address`, returning the transaction hash and persisting the transaction, receipt, and decoded logs for later status/log retrieval. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid parameters, NOT_FOUND if the signing `account_id` is not found (or no default is set), and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use that local account to sign. Raises CONFLICT if the server cannot resolve a signing context, RPC_ERROR if the transfer is rejected/reverts (including not owner/approved or non-existent token), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if transaction submission limits are exceeded.

contract_address.description: Private ERC721 contract address of the token to transfer.

to_address.description: Recipient address to transfer the NFT to.

token_id.description: Token ID to transfer (as a string to avoid integer size limits).

account_id.description: Locally-managed COTI account id that will initiate/sign the transfer transaction.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to submit the transaction to.

tool_schemas.name: get_native_balance
tool_schemas.description: Returns the native COTI balance for the provided account address via an on-chain read call on the selected `chain_id` (or server default) and records the result for repeatable reads. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the address is missing or malformed, RPC_ERROR if the chain query fails, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

address.description: COTI account address to query the native token balance for.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to target for the balance query.

tool_schemas.name: transfer_native
tool_schemas.description: Submits a native COTI transfer transaction from a locally-managed account (or the current default account if account_id is omitted) to to_address for the exact amount_wei, and returns the resulting transaction hash once the transaction is accepted for broadcast. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if to_address is not a valid address, amount_wei is not a non-negative integer string, or chain_id/account_id (when provided) is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the specified account_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account cannot be decrypted/unlocked for signing or is not permitted for the requested chain. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request/rate limits are exceeded, and raises INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS if the sender balance cannot cover amount_wei plus fees or the node rejects the transfer for funds/gas-related reasons.

to_address.description: Recipient address to send native COTI tokens to.

amount_wei.description: Amount of native token to transfer, denominated in Wei (integer string).

account_id.description: Locally-managed COTI account id that will initiate/sign the transfer.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to submit the transaction to.

tool_schemas.name: call_contract_function
tool_schemas.description: Performs an eth_call-style, read-only invocation of function_name on contract_address using the provided abi_json (when required to encode/decode) and inputs, and returns the decoded result in a human-readable form; this tool does not submit a transaction and does not change chain state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if contract_address is invalid, function_name is empty, the ABI cannot be parsed/does not contain the function, or inputs do not satisfy the function’s parameter types; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced account_id (when provided) does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the call requires an account context and the specified/default account cannot be decrypted/unlocked, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED or RPC_ERROR when upstream rate limits are hit or the node rejects/reverts the call.

contract_address.description: Target smart contract address to call.

inputs.description: Key/value mapping of function parameters to pass to the call.

abi_json.description: Contract ABI JSON used to encode the call and decode the result.

account_id.description: Locally-managed COTI account id to use for context/decryption if the call returns private data.

chain_id.description: COTI chain id to target for the read call.

tool_schemas.name: decode_event_data
tool_schemas.description: Decodes a single log entry’s topics and data using event_signature (topic0) and returns the event name (when derivable) plus decoded parameter names/values. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if event_signature/topics/data are not valid 0x-hex values, topics[0] does not match event_signature, or the topic/data payload lengths are inconsistent with the event definition. Raises NOT_FOUND when the event signature is unknown to the decoder and no matching event schema is available to decode against.

topics.description: Array of log topics (0x-prefixed hex strings) from the transaction log, including topic0.

data.description: The 0x-prefixed hex data field from the transaction log.

tool_schemas.name: get_transaction_logs
tool_schemas.description: Returns decoded log entries for the transaction identified by tx_hash, including raw topics/data and any known decoded event fields, and paginates results with limit and an opaque cursor returned in the response when more logs are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tx_hash is not a valid 0x-prefixed hash or if limit is provided but is < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the transaction is unknown and no logs are recorded or retrievable for it. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request/rate limits are exceeded, and raises RPC_ERROR when the backend cannot retrieve logs from the chain for the given transaction.

tx_hash.description: The 0x-prefixed transaction hash to retrieve logs for.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous request.

tool_schemas.name: get_transaction_status
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the latest known status for tx_hash (e.g., pending/confirmed/failed) along with available receipt/metadata, using chain_id to disambiguate networks when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tx_hash is not a valid 0x-prefixed hash or chain_id is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the transaction is not known on the specified/implicit chain and has no recorded submission in this backend. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request/rate limits are exceeded, and raises RPC_ERROR when the chain cannot be queried for status due to upstream errors.

tx_hash.description: The 0x-prefixed transaction hash to check status for.

chain_id.description: Optional chain ID to disambiguate which network to query.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_transaction_status(tx_hash, chain_id=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0345000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0345000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    req_id = "req_" + hashlib.sha256((str(time.time()) + "|get_transaction_status").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _record(status, error_code=None):
        crypto_ops = _load("crypto_operations.json")
        op_id = "coti_op_" + hashlib.sha256((req_id + "|call").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24]
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        crypto_ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "op_type": "call_contract_function",
            "account_id": None,
            "contract_address": None,
            "function_selector": None,
            "function_name": "get_transaction_status",
            "inputs_json": {"tx_hash": tx_hash, "chain_id": chain_id, "request_id": req_id, "latency_ms": latency_ms},
            "result_json": {"status": status, "error_code": error_code} if status != "succeeded" else {"status": status},
            "status": "succeeded" if status == "succeeded" else "failed",
            "error_message": None if status == "succeeded" else (error_code or "failed"),
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("crypto_operations.json", crypto_ops)

    if not isinstance(tx_hash, str) or re.fullmatch(r"^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", tx_hash) is None:
        _record("failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tx_hash must be a valid 0x-prefixed 32-byte hash")
    if chain_id is not None and not isinstance(chain_id, int):
        _record("failed", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "chain_id must be an integer when provided")

    txs = _load("transactions.json")

    # Resolve tx
    candidates = [r for r in txs if isinstance(r, dict) and (r.get("tx_hash") or "").lower() == tx_hash.lower()]
    if chain_id is not None:
        candidates = [r for r in candidates if r.get("chain_id") == chain_id]
    if not candidates:
        _record("failed", "NOT_FOUND")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Transaction not found on the specified/implicit chain")

    tx = candidates[0]

    # "Refresh from chain" cannot be done offline; maintain recorded status.
    # Enforce lifecycle consistency if fields imply transition requirements (do not mutate on read unless repairable).
    status = tx.get("status")
    if status in ("confirmed", "failed"):
        if tx.get("mined_at") is None or tx.get("block_number") is None:
            # Recorded row violates constraint; do not pretend success.
            _record("failed", "CONFLICT")
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Stored transaction is inconsistent: mined_at and block_number must be set when status is confirmed/failed")

    _record("succeeded")
    return {
        "transaction": {
            "id": tx.get("id"),
            "chain_id": tx.get("chain_id"),
            "tx_hash": tx.get("tx_hash"),
            "status": tx.get("status"),
            "failure_reason": tx.get("failure_reason"),
            "submitted_at": tx.get("submitted_at"),
            "mined_at": tx.get("mined_at"),
            "block_number": tx.get("block_number"),
            "tool_name": tx.get("tool_name"),
            "tx_type": tx.get("tx_type"),
            "to_address": tx.get("to_address"),
            "contract_id": tx.get("contract_id"),
            "value_wei": tx.get("value_wei"),
            "function_selector": tx.get("function_selector"),
            "call_data_hex": tx.get("call_data_hex"),
            "inputs_json": tx.get("inputs_json")
        },
        "meta": {"request_id": req_id, "timestamp": now}
    }

tool_schemas.name: get_account

tool_schemas.name: archive_account

account_id.description: ID of the account to archive.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for archiving (stored in audit metadata).
